title: Learning to Prompt: Improving Student Engagement with Adaptive LLM-based High-School Tutoring
title_zh: 学习提示：用自适应 LLM 高中辅导提升学生参与度
abstract_en: LLMs can personalize education, although current static-prompt tutoring systems struggle to adapt to diverse academic disciplines. We develop and test a system with subject-aware prompting, based on 14 pedagogical features (e.g., tutor scaffolding, student understanding) extracted from raw transcripts. We first train a prompt routing model in a simulation environment, and then deploy it for online adaptation with actual high-school students. The simulation benchmark shows the router outperforming two static baselines ($0.694$ vs. $0.647$ and $0.64$, $p<0.001$). A/B testing ($N=656$ conversations from 359 students) shows sim-to-real transfer where the model switches from analytical to scaffolding learning strategies. Our adaptive prompt selection mechanism improves instructional efficiency, maintains pedagogical quality and reduces interactions by around 3 turns ($p=0.007$). While a greedy router achieves a comparable exercise conversion rate with the baseline ($19.1\%$ vs. $19.6\%$), a stochastic router that samples strategies leads to a higher conversion rate ($28.1\%$).
abstract_zh: 本文研究如何通过自适应提示（adaptive prompting）提升 LLM 高中辅导系统的学生参与度与教学效率。作者提出一个具备学科感知（subject-aware）能力的提示路由系统，基于从原始对话转录中提取的 14 类教学特征（如 tutor scaffolding、student understanding）来选择合适的辅导策略。系统先在模拟环境中训练 prompt routing model，再部署到真实高中学生场景中进行在线适配。模拟基准中，该路由器显著优于两个静态提示基线（0.694 vs. 0.647/0.64，p<0.001）。真实 A/B 测试包含 359 名学生的 656 段对话，结果显示该方法具备 sim-to-real transfer 能力，并会从偏分析型策略切换到更多 scaffolding 策略。自适应提示选择在保持教学质量的同时提升教学效率，使互动轮次平均减少约 3 轮（p=0.007）。贪心路由器的练习转化率与基线接近（19.1% vs. 19.6%），而随机采样策略的路由器将转化率提升至 28.1%。
key_points_zh: 提出 subject-aware prompt routing system，根据学科与对话中的 14 类教学特征动态选择辅导提示策略。
先在模拟环境训练路由模型，再部署到真实高中生在线辅导场景，验证 sim-to-real transfer。
模拟实验中，路由器显著优于两个静态提示基线，得分为 0.694 vs. 0.647/0.64（p<0.001）。
真实 A/B 测试显示，自适应提示可维持教学质量并减少约 3 轮交互，提升教学效率。
随机策略路由器相比贪心路由器获得更高练习转化率，达到 28.1%，优于基线约 19.6%。

llm_assessment.comment: The adaptive prompt-routing tutor shows a modest closed-loop orchestration pattern with simulation-to-real deployment and A/B evaluation, though it remains domain-specific and prompt-centric.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该自适应提示路由导师体现了一定的闭环编排、仿真到真实部署和A/B评估价值，但仍较领域特定且以提示选择为中心。
